UO2-NVE-2x2x2-1700K.deck:
# set periodic boundaries, units and thero-baro damping
boundary p p p
atom_style full
units metal
variable dt equal 0.002 

# import UO2 single cell fluorite structure and assign atom labels
read_data /local/scratch/grassell/Simulations/lammps_simulations/UO2/UO2-unitcell.lmpstruct
variable U equal 1
variable O equal 2

# set charges
set type $U charge 2.2208
set type $O charge -1.1104

# define interatomic potential via coulombic and embed_UO2.fs tabulation 
kspace_style pppm 1.0e-5
variable SR_CUTOFF equal 11.0
pair_style hybrid/overlay coul/long ${SR_CUTOFF} eam/alloy
pair_coeff   *    *    coul/long
pair_coeff   *    *    eam/alloy /local/scratch/grassell/Simulations/lammps_simulations/UO2/CeThUNpPuAmCmO.eam.alloy U O

change_box all x final 0.0 5.65  y final 0.0 5.65  z final 0.0 5.65        

replicate  2 2 2

timestep   ${dt}

#########################################################################
### Simulation:  equilibration
#########################################################################

# setup output
thermo       250  # timesteps
thermo_style custom step time temp ke pe etotal press vol density

variable     T_eq     equal  1700 # Kelvin
variable     T_fi     equal  1700  # Kelvin
# Sample initial velocities
velocity     all create ${T_eq} 9790331 mom yes rot yes dist gaussian

dump         DUMP_RELAX all custom 250 UO2-equil.lammpstrj id type xu yu zu

variable     nvt_tau     equal  0.200             # [ps] -- NVT thermostat coupling time
# CSVR equilibration
fix          NVE_RELAX all nve
fix          CSVR_RELAX all temp/csvr ${T_eq} ${T_fi} ${nvt_tau} 231110
run          50000
unfix        CSVR_RELAX

# NVE equilibration
run          5000
unfix        NVE_RELAX
undump       DUMP_RELAX

write_restart UO2-equil.rst
write_data    UO2-equil.init

#########################################################################
### Simulation:  production
#########################################################################

#
compute         potenperatom all pe/atom
compute         kinenperatom all ke/atom
# 
compute         myStress all stress/atom NULL virial
compute         myHeatFlux all heat/flux kinenperatom potenperatom myStress         
#
group           Oxygens type $O
compute         VOx Oxygens reduce sum vx 
compute         VOy Oxygens reduce sum vy 
compute         VOz Oxygens reduce sum vz 

# Calcolo tensore sforzi

compute myPress all stress/atom NULL
compute sfo all reduce sum c_myPress[*]
variable sforzo_xx equal c_sfo[1]/vol
variable sforzo_yy equal c_sfo[2]/vol
variable sforzo_zz equal c_sfo[3]/vol
variable sforzo_xy equal c_sfo[4]/vol
variable sforzo_yz equal c_sfo[5]/vol
variable sforzo_xz equal c_sfo[6]/vol

thermo_style    custom step time etotal pe temp press lx c_myHeatFlux[1] c_myHeatFlux[2] c_myHeatFlux[3]     c_VOx c_VOy c_VOz v_sforzo_xx v_sforzo_yy v_sforzo_zz v_sforzo_xy v_sforzo_yz v_sforzo_xz
thermo 4

velocity all zero linear
velocity all zero angular

variable   traj_print_interval   equal 250

reset_timestep 0
dump         DUMP_RUN all custom ${traj_print_interval} UO2-run.lammpstrj id type xu yu zu vx vy vz fx fy fz

# Production
fix          NVE_PROD all nve
# fix          CSVR all temp/csvr ${T_fi} ${T_fi} ${nvt_tau} 231110
run          400000
# unfix        CSVR
unfix        NVE_PROD

set type $O charge -1.1104

# define interatomic potential via coulombic and embed_UO2.fs tabulation 
kspace_style pppm 1.0e-5
variable SR_CUTOFF equal 11.0
pair_style hybrid/overlay coul/long ${SR_CUTOFF} eam/alloy
pair_coeff   *    *    coul/long
pair_coeff   *    *    eam/alloy /local/scratch/grassell/Simulations/lammps_simulations/UO2/CeThUNpPuAmCmO.eam.alloy U O

change_box all x final 0.0 5.65  y final 0.0 5.65  z final 0.0 5.65        

replicate  2 2 2

timestep   ${dt}

#########################################################################
### Simulation:  equilibration
#########################################################################

# setup output
thermo       250  # timesteps
thermo_style custom step time temp ke pe etotal press vol density

variable     T_fi     equal  3100  # Kelvin

fix          NVE_RELAX all nve
fix          CSVR_RELAX all temp/csvr ${T_eq} ${T_fi} ${nvt_tau} 231110
run          50000
unfix        CSVR_RELAX

# NVE equilibration

unfix        NVE_RELAX
undump       DUMP_RELAX

write_restart UO2-equil.rst
write_data    UO2-equil.init

#########################################################################

#########################################################################

compute         VOy Oxygens reduce sum vy 
compute         VOz Oxygens reduce sum vz

compute sfo all reduce sum c_myPress[*]
variable sforzo_xx equal c_sfo[1]/vol
variable sforzo_yy equal c_sfo[2]/vol
variable sforzo_zz equal c_sfo[3]/vol
variable sforzo_xy equal c_sfo[4]/vol
variable sforzo_yz equal c_sfo[5]/vol
variable sforzo_xz equal c_sfo[6]/vol

thermo_style    custom step time etotal pe temp press lx c_myHeatFlux[1] c_myHeatFlux[2] c_myHeatFlux[3]     c_VOx c_VOy c_VOz v_sforzo_xx v_sforzo_yy v_sforzo_zz v_sforzo_xy v_sforzo_yz v_sforzo_xz
thermo 4

velocity all zero linear
velocity all zero angular

variable   traj_print_interval   equal 250

reset_timestep 0
dump         DUMP_RUN all custom ${traj_print_interval} UO2-run.lammpstrj id type xu yu zu vx vy vz fx fy fz

# Production
fix          NVE_PROD all nve
fix          CSVR all temp/csvr ${T_fi} ${T_fi} ${nvt_tau} 231110
run          400000
unfix        CSVR
unfix        NVE_PROD

variable U equal 1
variable O equal 2

# set charges
set type $U charge 2.2208
set type $O charge -1.1104

# define interatomic potential via coulombic and embed_UO2.fs tabulation 
kspace_style pppm 1.0e-5
variable SR_CUTOFF equal 11.0
pair_style hybrid/overlay coul/long ${SR_CUTOFF} eam/alloy
pair_coeff   *    *    coul/long
pair_coeff   *    *    eam/alloy /local/scratch/grassell/Simulations/lammps_simulations/UO2/CeThUNpPuAmCmO.eam.alloy U O

change_box all x final 0.0 5.65  y final 0.0 5.65  z final 0.0 5.65

unfix        CSVR_RELAX

unfix        NVE_RELAX

variable sforzo_xy equal c_sfo[4]/vol
variable sforzo_yz equal c_sfo[5]/vol
variable sforzo_xz equal c_sfo[6]/vol

thermo_style    custom step time etotal pe temp press lx c_myHeatFlux[1] c_myHeatFlux[2] c_myHeatFlux[3]     c_VOx c_VOy c_VOz v_sforzo_xx v_sforzo_yy v_sforzo_zz v_sforzo_xy v_sforzo_yz v_sforzo_xz

velocity all zero angular

dump         DUMP_RUN all custom ${traj_print_interval} UO2-run.lammpstrj id type xu yu zu vx vy vz fx fy fz

# Production
fix          NVE_PROD all nve
fix          CSVR all temp/csvr ${T_fi} ${T_fi} ${nvt_tau} 231110

unfix        CSVR

CaF2-NVE-2x2x2-1000K.deck:
# Simulazione su CaF2 superionico 
        echo both
        # Variabili definite da utente
        # Costanti fondamentali
        variable     kB         equal  1.3806504e-23    # [J/K]
        variable     kB_eV      equal  8.617343e-5
        variable     NA         equal  6.02214e23       # [1/mol]
        variable     massunit   equal  1.660538921e-27  # [kg]
        variable     V          equal  vol
        variable     eV         equal  1.60218e-19      # eV in Joules
        variable     dt         equal  0.004          # [ps] -- MD time step
        # Variabili CaF2; tratte da https://doi.org/10.1051/jphyscol:1980606 (1980)
        # specie 1 = + (Ca, carico 2+)
        # specie 2 = - (F,  carico 1-)
        variable        alat    equal      5.712 # Angstrom
        # Creazione cella
        dimension       3
        units           metal
        boundary        p p p
        atom_style      charge
        lattice         fcc ${alat} origin 0 0 0        # Lattice for Ca system
        region          box block 0 1 0 1 0 1 units lattice
        create_box      2 box # 2 atom-type number, box è il nome per la scatola
        create_atoms    1 box
        lattice         custom   1.0     &
                a1      ${alat}       0.0     0.0     &
                a2      0.0      ${alat}      0.0     &
                a3      0.0      0.0     ${alat}      &
                basis   0.25  0.25  0.75              &
                basis   0.25  0.75  0.25              &
                basis   0.75  0.25  0.25              &
                basis   0.75  0.75  0.75              &
                basis   0.75  0.75  0.25              &
                basis   0.75  0.25  0.75              &
                basis   0.25  0.75  0.75              &
                basis   0.25  0.25  0.25              # Lattice for F2 system
        create_atoms    2 box
        # Masse e cariche
        mass 1 40.078       # massa Ca
        mass 2 18.998403    # massa F
        set type 1 charge +2
        set type 2 charge -1
        # Somme Ewald
        kspace_style ewald 1.0e-5  # corretto???

        variable     kB_eV      equal  8.617343e-5
        variable     NA         equal  6.02214e23       # [1/mol]
        variable     massunit   equal  1.660538921e-27  # [kg]
        variable     V          equal  vol
        variable     eV         equal  1.60218e-19      # eV in Joules
        variable     dt         equal  0.004          # [ps] -- MD time step
        # Variabili CaF2; tratte da https://doi.org/10.1051/jphyscol:1980606 (1980)
        # specie 1 = + (Ca, carico 2+)
        # specie 2 = - (F,  carico 1-)
        variable        alat    equal      5.712 # Angstrom
        # Creazione cella
        dimension       3
        units           metal
        boundary        p p p
        atom_style      charge
        lattice         fcc ${alat} origin 0 0 0        # Lattice for Ca system
        region          box block 0 1 0 1 0 1 units lattice
        create_box      2 box # 2 atom-type number, box è il nome per la scatola
        create_atoms    1 box
        lattice         custom   1.0     &
                a1      ${alat}       0.0     0.0     &
                a2      0.0      ${alat}      0.0     &
                a3      0.0      0.0     ${alat}      &
                basis   0.25  0.25  0.75              &
                basis   0.25  0.75  0.25              &
                basis   0.75  0.25  0.25              &
                basis   0.75  0.75  0.75              &
                basis   0.75  0.75  0.25              &
                basis   0.75  0.25  0.75              &
                basis   0.25  0.75  0.75              &
                basis   0.25  0.25  0.25              # Lattice for F2 system
        create_atoms    2 box

        set type 1 charge +2
        set type 2 charge -1

        run          50000
        unfix        CSVR_RELAX

        run          5000
        unfix        NVE_RELAX
        undump       DUMP_RELAX
        
        write_restart CaF2-equil.rst
        write_data    CaF2-equil.init
